verdict.rationale: Smithery's maintained CLI documents registering MCP servers (`smithery mcp add <url>`) and calling their tools (`smithery tool call`), so the product itself can plug in MCP servers and use their tools. However, the hosted Connect/Toolbox service that brokered connections, OAuth and token refresh was shut down on 2026-10-31, and the service-tied CLI and SDK versions were deprecated, so the current depth of the tool-calling path is unproven. Missing for 10: confirmed post-shutdown connection and auth handling for added servers, hands-on corroboration that tool calls work against the public registry, and current first-party docs (the docs tree was removed).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
